_README: Voice front-end for the EXISTING DHL AI Command Center. The voice platform (Vapi or Retell) only handles the live call — speech-to-text, turn-taking, text-to-speech. The BRAIN is your DHL_AI_Command_Center workflow, reached through its already-built omnichannel webhook. No duplicate tools. Set the Custom LLM / webhook URL to your Command Center's /webhook/dhl-omnichannel endpoint (via ngrok or n8n Cloud).
name: DHL Voice Front-End — Robo
firstMessage: Thanks for calling DHL! This is Robo. I can track a shipment, reschedule a delivery, book a pickup, or help with a damaged parcel. How can I help?

request_body_template.from: {{ caller phone number or call id }}

brain.note: The Command Center does ALL the work: normalize -> triage router -> 5 specialist agents -> 12 tools -> reply. It already shortens replies when channel = voice. The voice platform just speaks back the 'output' field.

fillerWhileThinking: Let me check that for you, one moment...
endCallMessage: Thanks for calling DHL. Have a great day!
_HOW_TO_WIRE_IN_VAPI: 2. Set the Model to 'Custom LLM' and point its URL at your Command Center webhook (https://YOUR-N8N-URL/webhook/dhl-omnichannel).
3. Configure the request body to send { message, channel: 'voice', from } as above.
4. Set Voice = an Indian English 11labs voice; Transcriber = Deepgram nova-2, en-IN.
6. Click 'Talk to Assistant' to test in the browser.
_RETELL_ALTERNATIVE: In Retell, create an agent with a 'Custom LLM' webhook pointing at the same Command Center URL. Retell makes it easy to read a JSON field ('output') as the spoken reply.
